correctness.rationale: For every m≥2, B>0, τ>0, symmetry averaging is valid because λ2 is concave and costs are invariant. The exact spectrum is {0,(m+1)x,x [m−1 times],x+2y [m−1 times],eig(M)} with M=[[mx+2z,−sqrt(m)x],[−sqrt(m)x,x+2y]]. The normalization λ2≥1 forces x≥1 and M−I positive semidefinite, whose Schur complement gives the exact necessary and sufficient bound y≥[mx²/(mx+2z−1)−(x−1)]/2. The cost lower bound Fτ is minimized analytically: when τ≤(m/(m−1))² its free z-minimizer is feasible at x=1 and cost grows with x; otherwise z=0 and the remaining bound is strictly increasing in x. Equality reconstructs the stated nonnegative design with λ2 exactly B/D. The unique symmetric optimizer and shortcut fixed by every symmetry imply all global optimizers have the same shortcut weight. At the optimum the Fiedler eigenvalue has multiplicity m. The standalone scripts executed from the new package verified 30 exact-rational full spectra/budgets, 90 numerical eigenspectra and budgets, 9,000 feasible asymmetric alternatives, and 12 local constrained optimizations. Finite tests are not used to prove universality.

originality.rationale: The closest inspected primary source, Sun--Boyd--Xiao--Diaconis (2006), already formalizes this cost-weighted continuous-time spectral-gap maximization as an SDP and shows qualitatively that a costly edge may vanish, but its explicitly solved graph examples are a triangular-tail graph, paths, and cycles, not the family of m three-edge parallel paths plus a shortcut. The new all-parameter closed form, threshold and every-optimum shortcut rule are not supplied there. Boyd--Diaconis--Parrilo--Xiao (2009) use a discrete-time SLEM objective, and Shakeri et al. (2015) hold intralayer edge rates fixed. Exact compared historical results optimize a spanning-tree determinant on a larger theta family or λ2 on other graph families: neither implies this λ2 cost threshold. Targeted scholarly and mathematical-index searches found no decisive exact counterpart, but cannot establish exhaustive originality.
residual_risks: A historical exact specialized solution in an unindexed thesis, proceedings, or differently named family could still establish this same threshold.

value.rationale: A natural cost-heterogeneous series-parallel network design problem exhibits an exact sharp phase transition: a redundant shortcut with initially positive optimal conductance must be removed from every global optimizer when its relative unit cost exceeds τc=(m/(m−1))², and the optimized mixing rate then plateaus. The theorem gives all-m, all-positive-cost closed forms and an all-unrestricted-optimizers support rule rather than a special value or routine instance. Comparing with the distinct spanning-tree determinant objective at m=4 and τ=1 shows the support pattern depends substantively on the spectral design criterion. A resource-allocation decision rule and a new analytic phase boundary are directly useful to studying weighted consensus/transport design.
